items.title: ECU Falls At Memphis In Overtime, 41-34
items.summary: Memphis, Tenn. – East Carolina suffered a devastating dose of déjà vu in consecutive Thursday night American Conference road games.

items.title: ECU Announces Halloween Ticket Special And Game Day Festivities For Temple Matchup
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. — Pirate Nation is in for a treat this Halloween as ECU Athletics announces special ticket pricing and a full lineup of activities surrounding the Pirates' football game against Temple on Saturday, Oct. 31, at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium.  Kickoff is set for 3 p.m.

items.title: ECU Travels To Memphis For Thursday Night Game On ESPN2
East Carolina, App State To Meet In 2029 Duke’s Mayo Classic In Charlotte
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – East Carolina and App State will renew their regional rivalry on a prominent stage in the Queen City, meeting in the 2029 Duke's Mayo Classic at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte, N.C. the Charlotte Sports Foundation and both institutions announced Tuesday.

items.title: ECU Falls At UAB In Overtime, 30-17
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – East Carolina's second venture to the state of Alabama turned from probable celebration into a stunned moment in a matter of minutes Thursday night at Protective Stadium.

items.title: ECU Plays At UAB Thursday On ESPN At 7:30 P.M.
ECU, Coastal Carolina Announce Football Series Extension Through 2034
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – East Carolina and Coastal Carolina have agreed to extend their regional non-conference football series through the 2034 season, the two institutions announced Monday. items.title: ECU Wins American Conference Opener Over Rice, 28-12
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – The threat of rain and wind from the remnants of Hurricane Isaia put a small damper on East Carolina's annual homecoming game and American Conference opener. But another big day from T.J. Engleman Jr. combined with a relentless defense ensured the party would not be spoiled.

items.title: ECU Opens American Conference Play Hosting Rice At 1 P.M.
ECU-Rice Kickoff Moved To 1 P.M. Saturday
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – Due to the forecast of inclement weather in Greenville and surrounding areas during the late afternoon and evening, kickoff for Saturday's ECU football game against Rice at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium has been moved to 1 p.m.
